scientific_question: Does a single half-order homogeneous Sobolev penalty reduce the five-camera gradient-tail oversmoothing seen in v159.1 while preserving every frozen time-by-camera adequacy gate?
role: post-open private controlled-proxy mechanism diagnostic; not a learned method, not true experimental pairing, and not a deployment or resource result
physical_hypothesis: The sole v159.1 miss is consistent with excessive high-frequency attenuation by the integer-order H1 penalty. Replacing the squared spatial-frequency weight by its square root tests a physically distinct, less smoothing prior without changing the data, field basis, observation model, multiplier, or gate.

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is the reconstructed density field; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and two-component observations are generated by code for the controlled proxy; no true experiment pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior on 2026-08-18

inputs.models: the same nine CPU-adapted TorchScript models sealed by v157-v159
inputs.calibrations: the same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v159

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.primary_penalty: homogeneous H^(1/2) seminorm: sqrt(sum_i (pi*k_i/span_i)^2), normalized to median one
representation.comparison_penalty: the frozen homogeneous H1 seminorm from v159.1: sum_i (pi*k_i/span_i)^2, normalized to median one
representation.geometry_scale: median positive generalized normal eigenvalue above max-eigenvalue times 1e-12

arms.forbidden_alternatives: no other fractional order, multiplier, basis size, camera subset, fallback, or per-sample selector is evaluated

regularization.origin: held identical to v159.1 after median-normalizing the new penalty; not selected from v160 results

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; all camera subsets, arms, models, and times reuse sealed geometry
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact reduced A-transpose equivalent for B^T y and one exact reduced A equivalent for the final projection
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: rebuild camera rays and sparse operators with the independent v156 numerical path
independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy idctn basis construction
independent_recomputation.fractional_penalty: independently compute Euclidean spatial-frequency magnitude from integer modes and physical spans
required_comparisons: the frozen v159.1 H1 control rows and summaries

decision_order: Any input, source-semantics, operator, basis, penalty, density, stationarity, residual, accounting, historical-control, or independent-recomputation failure makes v160 inconclusive.
Only fractional order 0.5 and multiplier 0.03 are primary; no alternative may replace them after results.

The primary passes only if every one of the twelve time-by-camera strata passes all absolute gates, each nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and the formerly failed t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly lower than the frozen H1 value.
A valid failure closes this half-order spectral-prior hypothesis and does not authorize parameter search, a larger model, or GPU rescue.

A valid pass establishes only controlled-proxy temporal reference adequacy and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
